title: Save check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A probe for core-a4mk2 0.6's ev_project_save on the Analog Four MKII: it counts the calls before and after each project save and adds 1 to a project field before each one, so a saved copy carries the count of saves made before it. Bars at the bottom of the screen show the counts, the field and the last save's kind and slot; the same counts are in RAM after the magic SVC1.
